fixed_constraints: The target abliterated Qwen-class 4B is fully Clay-native in generated/thought symbolic language after full-model adaptation.
Clay is the target semantic language of memory, state, values/vector semantics, architecture, GWT, Assemblies, Hyperposition and inter-module communication.
Clay/ClayCode is the semantic architecture source of truth; implementation languages are compiled/execution substrates, not competing semantic architectures.
ClayGraph is the target persistent semantic memory/knowledge substrate, subject to exact-authority, epoch, provenance, activation and migration safety constraints.
Needle is the sole intentionally retained non-Clay semantic subsystem and is used fully as a fast classifier/router.
Needle output is bridged into Clay as typed provenance-bound input and does not mint execution authority.
Neural tensors/KV/numeric arrays may remain physical numeric encodings but semantic crossings must be Clay-typed.
Research may challenge implementation mechanisms and predicted benefits but must not reopen the owner-fixed decision that the target FRANK is Clay-native end to end except Needle.
research_scope: Measure consequences, optimize implementation, find failure modes, design training/migration/evaluation, and feed results to all seven scientific branches.
